items.name: pi_eq_sum_univ'
items.type: {ι : Type u_7} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_8} [NonAssocSemiring R] (x : ι → R) : x = ∑ i, x i • Pi.single i 1

items.name: pi_eq_sum_univ
items.type: {ι : Type u_7} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type u_8} [NonAssocSemiring R] (x : ι → R) : x = ∑ i, x i • fun j => if i = j then 1 else 0

items.name: Finsupp.sum_nsmul
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {N : Type u_10} [AddCommMonoid N] [Fintype α] (f : α →₀ ℕ) (g : α → N) : (f.sum fun a b => b • g a) = ∑ a, f a • g a

items.name: Finsupp.sum_zsmul
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {N : Type u_16} [SubtractionCommMonoid N] [Fintype α] (f : α →₀ ℤ) (g : α → N) : (f.sum fun a b => b • g a) = ∑ a, f a • g a

items.name: Fintype.linearCombination_apply
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_3) [Fintype α] [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (v : α → M) (f : α → R) : (Fintype.linearCombination R v) f = ∑ i, f i • v i

items.name: Module.Basis.equivFun_symm_apply
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (x : ι → R) : b.equivFun.symm x = ∑ i, x i • b i

items.name: Module.Basis.constr_apply_fintype
items.type: {M' : Type u_5} [AddCommMonoid M'] {ι : Type u_7} {R : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module R M'] (S : Type u_11) [Semiring S] [Module S M'] [SMulCommClass R S M'] [Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (f : ι → M') (x : M) : ((b.constr S) f) x = ∑ i, b.equivFun x i • f i

items.name: List.alternatingSum_eq_finsetSum
items.type: {G : Type u_3} [SubtractionCommMonoid G] (L : List G) : L.alternatingSum = ∑ i, (-1) ^ ↑i • L[i]
